content.title: Rahmania Commercial Centres
summary: Secondary works for two commercial centres, completed in 2025 within Douira's 2,500-home residential programme.
Two commercial centres in Douira's 2,500-home programme, fitted out to host the district's shops and everyday services.
description: Igloo carried out the complete secondary works package for both centres, turning two reinforced-concrete structures into modern, functional spaces ready for traders and everyday users.

The facades combine large glazed surfaces with decorative screen elements. Inside, circulation is organised around a central staircase, while a pyramidal glass skylight brings natural light into the retail levels.
content.authority: Delivered in 2025, on schedule, with every finishing trade coordinated to the high standards demanded by a modern commercial building.
